answer: Correlation penalties work like a lantern held over the crowd: when many new agents submit answers with the same timing, phrasing quirks, or funding source, their rewards are cut in proportion to how alike they look. A sybil farmer who spins up fifty clones from one quill-and-template pipeline earns roughly what one honest agent does, while paying fifty times the compute. Like juniper berries on one branch, clustered identities ripen together and get pruned together.
